# patches

`patches.cpp`, `profile_patches.cpp`, and `xlive.cpp` integrate runtime engine patches, profile synchronization, offline-mode support, security guards, movement fixes, and anti-debugging behavior for Project: Consolation.

## Contents

- [patches.cpp](./patches.cpp) — `patches::component`, `patches::enforce_ads_sprint_interrupt`, dvar overrides, movement hooks, branding, offline-mode patches, window customization, and security self-tests.
- [patches.hpp](./patches.hpp) — Declares `patches::enforce_ads_sprint_interrupt`.
- [profile_patches.cpp](./profile_patches.cpp) — `profile_patches::component`, profile-config migration, encryption conversion, deduplication, console commands, and synchronization callbacks.
- [xlive.cpp](./xlive.cpp) — `xlive::apply_early`, anti-debugging API detours, PEB cleanup, `xlive.dll` import patching, and `PEVerifyHash` bypassing.
- [xlive.hpp](./xlive.hpp) — Declares `xlive::apply_early`.

## Architecture

`patches::component::post_load()` installs engine detours, dvar replacements, fixed-address patches, offline-mode behavior, and security guards during component initialization.

`profile_patches::component::post_load()` schedules profile migration and synchronization through startup, periodic, and shutdown callbacks.

`xlive::apply_early()` performs pre-component anti-debugging setup, while `xlive::component::post_load()` repeats `clear_peb_debug_flags()` and `patch_xlive()` after loading.

## API Surface

`patches::enforce_ads_sprint_interrupt(game::usercmd_t* cmd)` clears `game::BUTTON_SPRINT` when `game::BUTTON_ADS` is present and returns immediately for null `cmd`.

`xlive::apply_early()` applies early PEB, NTDLL, and `xlive.dll` patches.

`REGISTER_COMPONENT(patches::component)`, `REGISTER_COMPONENT(profile_patches::component)`, and the conditional `REGISTER_COMPONENT(xlive::component)` control component discovery.

## Behavioral Contracts

`build_version_string()` formats output as `Project: Consolation <shortversion> build <build-label> <timestamp> win-x86`.

`build_shortversion_string()` appends `-dbg` for `DEBUG` builds and `-nightly` for non-`DEBUG`/non-`NDEBUG` builds.

`build_build_label()` truncates `GIT_HASH` to seven characters and appends `-dirty` when `GIT_DIRTY` is true.

`local_offline_mode_requested()` recognizes `offline`, `local_offline`, and `local-offline`.

`create_window_ex_stub()` assigns `Project: Consolation - Multiplayer` to `JB_MP` windows.

`k_huffman_max_decoded_bytes`, `k_huffman_max_compressed_bytes`, `k_ui_replace_directive_max_len`, and `k_party_member_join_max_message_bytes` equal `0x20000`, `0x20000`, `0x100`, and `0x4000`.

`UI_ReplaceDirective_guard()` logs `UI_ReplaceDirective: rejected oversized directive input` for oversized input.

`PartyAtomicHost_HandleMemberJoin_guard()` logs `PartyAtomicHost_HandleMemberJoin: rejected malformed message cursor` and `PartyAtomicHost_HandleMemberJoin: rejected oversized message (%zu bytes)`.

`register_security_guard_self_test()` prints `securityGuardSelfTest: party=%s ui=%s`.

`looks_like_plaintext_config()` requires `seta `, `set `, or `unbindall` after printable-character validation.

`try_parse_dvar_assignment()` recognizes exact prefixes `seta ` and `set `.

`dedupe_config_text()` emits `\r\n` for CRLF input and `\n` otherwise.

`default_profile_config_name`, `custom_profile_config_name`, and `decrypted_profile_config_name` equal `config_mp.cfg`, `consolation_mp.cfg`, and `consolation_mp_decrypted.cfg`.

`print_profile_message()` formats through a fixed `1024`-byte buffer, while `dbg()` formats through a `512`-byte buffer.

`scan()` performs exact byte-pattern matching and returns `nullptr` for empty, undersized, or unmatched patterns.

`patch_peverifyhash()` writes `ret_success = { 0x31, 0xC0, 0xC2, 0x0C, 0x00 }` and uses fallback `peverifyhash_rva = 0x000F36B3u`.

`clear_peb_debug_flags()` clears PEB offset `0x02`, PEB offset `0x68`, FS offset `0x18`, and FS offset `0x30`.

`peb_cleaner_thread()` repeats `clear_peb_debug_flags()` followed by `Sleep(16)` indefinitely.

## Fixed Engine Contracts

`game::game_offset(0x10240B30)`, `game::game_offset(0x10240A30)`, and `game::game_offset(0x102489A1)` implement offline-mode bypasses.

`game::game_offset(0x101E6900)`, `game::game_offset(0x101E6930)`, `game::game_offset(0x10279010)`, and `game::game_offset(0x101DB390)` identify movement and renderer detours.

`game::game_offset(0x1030D960)`, `game::game_offset(0x102BB870)`, and `game::game_offset(0x103087B0)` identify security guard detours.

`game::game_offset(0x103ECCA0)` identifies the profile-config decryption transform.

`Jump_Start_stub()` assumes valid engine pointers and dvars, unlike `CL_ParseServerMessage_huffman_guard()` and `PartyAtomicHost_HandleMemberJoin_guard()`, which validate input pointers and message cursors.
